test_title: PYST 7: SSC MTS - Reasoning (Held on: 6 July 2022 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: Seven friends, Parv, Qazi, Raees, Sushil, Tania, Uma, and Vishnu are sitting around a circular table facing the centre. Parv is immediate neighbour of both Tania and Sushil. Uma is immediate neighbour of both Qazi and Vishnu. Qazi is sitting second to the right of Tania. Who is sitting to the immediate left of Qazi?
solution:
The pattern followed here is:

**Seven friends: **** **Parv, Qazi, Raees, Sushil, Tania, Uma, and Vishnu

1) Qazi is sitting second to the right of Tania.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6c75b64ae315117e8d7033aa5a86b66b7726821266d7e0d6845002878ce19b80.png] 

2) Uma is immediate neighbour of both Qazi and Vishnu.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c3ca78ac14ecebd8e5bc6fb8287322edd21ceb016a5db82f145f2d7d0288cd7c.png] 

3) Parv is immediate neighbour of both Tania and Sushil.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/43043eee558aa916f1e3eaed7ebf6adb14eaf15724a910ce12bc9084951bd4ca.png] 

4) Raees sitting on the vacant place.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1a0e3888341361be13b5a80e3efd917d07d589f5d30da1b766cc40351cf4a175.png] 

Clearly, **Raees**** **is sitting immediate left of **Qazi.**

Hence, the correct answer is **"Raees".**
